    List enviPath objects

    epList.Rd

    epList returns a list with info on objects available in enviPath.

    epList(type, pkg = NULL)

    Arguments

    type

    Character scalar.

    pkg

    Character scalar.

    Value

    A data frame.

    Examples

    #> Hi RiboRings, welcome to enviPath!
epList("package")

#> 1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  This Package was generated automatically for the batch prediction task.
#> 2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          This package was generated during registration.
#> 3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Package to make Prediction Models publicly available
#> 4                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  This Package was generated automatically for the batch prediction task.
#> 5                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   string
#> 6                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The "EAWAG-SEDIMENT" package contains pathways and kinetic data from biodegradation studies performed in water-sediment systems. This information is extracted from pesticide registration dossiers (draft assessment reports, DAR) made publically available through the European Food Safety Authority (<a href="https://www.efsa.europa.eu/en/calls/consultations" target="_blank">EFSA</a>). The package also contains information on different experimental conditions that are stored in the object <a href="https://envipath.org/package/f05e38d8-e9b4-4c3e-b0d8-9ab29966eccf/scenario" target="_blank">scenario</a>. <a href="https://envipath.org/package/f05e38d8-e9b4-4c3e-b0d8-9ab29966eccf/compound" target="_blank">Compounds</a> in the pathway are associated with a given <a href="https://envipath.org/package/f05e38d8-e9b4-4c3e-b0d8-9ab29966eccf/scenario" target="_blank">scenario</a> if they have been observed under the specific experimental conditions. If available, a total system biotransformation half-life (DT50) value is associated with a given compound in the pathway and a specific scenario, along with dissipation half-lives from the water and the sediment phases.
#> 7                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     A collection of literature-reported biotransformation pathways for per- and polyfluorinated alkyl substances (PFASs). Last updated on June 9th 2026.
#> 8                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  This Package was generated automatically for the batch prediction task.
#> 9  "EAWAG-SOIL" package contains pathway information from soil degradation studies, stored in a biotransformation reaction scheme in the object <a href="https://envipath.org/package/5882df9c-dae1-4d80-a40e-db4724271456/pathway" target="_blank">pathway</a>. This information is extracted from pesticide registration dossiers (draft assessment reports, DAR) made publically available through the European Food Safety Authority (<a href="https://www.efsa.europa.eu/en/calls/consultations" target="_blank">EFSA</a>). The package also contains information on different experimental conditions that are stored in the object <a href="https://envipath.org/package/5882df9c-dae1-4d80-a40e-db4724271456/scenario" target="_blank">scenario</a>. <a href="https://envipath.org/package/5882df9c-dae1-4d80-a40e-db4724271456/compound" target="_blank">Compounds</a> in the pathway are associated with a given <a href="https://envipath.org/package/5882df9c-dae1-4d80-a40e-db4724271456/scenario" target="_blank">scenario</a> if they have been observed under the specific experimental conditions. If available, a biotransformation half-life (DT50) value is additionally associated with a given compound in the pathway and a specific scenario. More details concerning enviPath conventions that were used to store specific data from DAR, and their description can be found in our <a href="https://wiki.envipath.org/doku.php?id=packages#eawag-soil" target="_blank">wiki</a>.
#> 10                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 This Package was generated automatically for the batch prediction task.
#> 11                                                                                                                                                                                                         The <a href="https://envipath.org/package/521c547a-fd2a-491c-ad5b-7eaa1577fb65">EAWAG-SLUDGE</a> package contains pathways and kinetic information about microbially mediated transformation processes in biological wastewater treatment. The information was extracted from scientific publications in different journals. The biotransformation reaction schemes are stored as <a href="https://envipath.org/package/4a3cd0f4-4d2b-4f00-b3e6-a29e721f7038/pathway">pathways</a>. The experimental conditions and additional information (e. g. sludge source) are collected in the <a href="https://envipath.org/package/4a3cd0f4-4d2b-4f00-b3e6-a29e721f7038/scenario">scenario</a> objects. Any observed transformation products (<a href="https://envipath.org/package/4a3cd0f4-4d2b-4f00-b3e6-a29e721f7038/compound">compounds</a>) are linked to their corresponding experimental metadata (<a href="https://envipath.org/package/4a3cd0f4-4d2b-4f00-b3e6-a29e721f7038/scenario">scenario</a>). Kinetic parameters (rate constants and/or half-lives) including corresponding scenarios are indicated for compounds for which such data is available. More details regarding enviPath conventions can be found in our <a href="https://wiki.envipath.com/index.php/Main_Page">wiki</a>.
#> 12                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  string

Once the pathways are peer-reviewed, this package will be merged into the enviPath-PFAS package.
